# Embedded conversion runtime

Place an approved official Windows x64 LibreOffice runtime here before creating a release. It must contain `program/soffice.exe`; Inno Setup copies this directory to the installed application's `runtime/libreoffice` directory.

Do not use a machine-wide installation or copy WPS/Microsoft Office files into the package. Record the upstream version, download source, SHA-256, and original license files in the release record and ship the required notices with the installer.
